//: SRS/ and Src/ are flat directories of sibling modules, not installed
packages. Modules reach each other by bare name, and SRS modules reach
into ../Src. The cross-tree import used to be arranged with
sys.path.insert at import time in certsingle.py and _deps.py, which a
static analyzer cannot follow; it reported
on a line that worked at run time. Both files now load by explicit file
path through _srclib.load_src_module instead, so the runtime problem is
gone -- but a bare-name import of a sibling is still not resolvable
statically, and tests/conftest.py still inserts paths for pytest.
Declaring the two roots here is the supported way to tell the analyzer
the truth, so the config stays.
reportMissingImports is 'warning' rather than 'error' on purpose: an
unresolved import should be visible without failing a check, since the
whole point of this tree is that a missing import is a defect worth
surfacing rather than one worth hiding behind a green build.
